recentItems.title: MVP Award Predictions + Rams CB Trent McDuffie Talks Super Bowl Expectations | The NFL Report
recentItems.description:
On today’s The NFL Report podcast, a fiery Colts GM Chris Ballard defends Kennan Allen after his arrest drunken driving chargers. We hear the latest on the contract talks for quarterback’s Baker Mayfield and C.J. Stroud. We’ll hear from Rams cornerback Trent McDuffie about what it’ll be like playing with future Hall of Famers Myles Garrett and Aaron Donald. Plus, Bucky Brooks gives his surprising predictions for MVP and other major season awards.
